scope: Topics (materi pokok/ATP), TP, fokus materi, and JP for Pendidikan Agama Kristen, Katolik, Hindu, Buddha, and Khonghucu dan Budi Pekerti, SD grades 1-6, semesters 1-2. Islam is covered by KM-SD-2026-R2.

source.allocation: Same as PAI in KM-SD-2026-R2: 3 JP per week; semester 1 = 18 weeks (54 JP); semester 2 = 18 weeks (54 JP), grade 6 = 14 weeks (42 JP).

authoring.method: AI-assisted draft from the verified CP text, one CP element or sub-element per topic, ordered to cover every CP of the phase across its two grades. Not yet reviewed.

conventions: Shape follows the data model tables topics, learning_objectives (TP), focus_items, and focus_item_objectives (docs/drafts/data-model.md#curriculum); KM-SD-2026-R2 field names map as Materi Pokok -> title, Data_Tujuan -> learning_objectives, Data_ATP -> atp_code/order/jp/weeks, Data_Fokus -> focus_items.

Codes follow the KM-SD-2026-R2 pattern: topic <version>-<subject>-K<grade>-<nn>, ATP-<subject>-K<grade>-BAB-<nn>, TP-<subject>-K<grade>-<nn>-<mm>, FM-<subject>-K<grade>-<nn>-<mm>. Topic numbers run across both semesters of a grade.
Subject codes: PAKR Kristen, PAKT Katolik, PAH Hindu, PAB Buddha, PAKH Khonghucu.
Each fokus is one week of 3 JP. The JP of the fokus always add up to the topic jp_total, and the topics of a semester fill its effective weeks exactly.
focus_items[].objective_codes links each fokus to the TP it serves (drafted by order; the reviewer may change it).
cp_text is copied from the CP dataset for the topic's element (Kristen: sub-element). Spelling of names and terms follows that dataset.
references.book names the Kemendikbudristek student book for the grade as a reference; book_pages stays null until a reviewer checks the edition.

topics.title: Sembahyang sebagai Wujud Lǐ (礼)
topics.cp_text: Menginterpretasikan hari raya/sembahyang kepada Tiān (天), Nabi Kǒngzǐ (孔子), shénmíng (神明), dan leluhur sebagai wujud kesusilaan (lǐ 礼); menjelaskan perlengkapan dan peralatan sembahyang sehingga menumbuhkan keimanan dan kepribadian luhur.

learning_objectives.text: Murid mampu menginterpretasikan sembahyang hari raya sebagai wujud lǐ.
Murid mampu menunjukkan sikap susila dalam ibadah.

topics.title: Bakti kepada Tiāndìrén (天地人)
topics.cp_text: Menerapkan sikap cinta kasih kepada seluruh makhluk ciptaan Tiān (天), cinta tanah air, hidup tepasalira dan harmonis kepada sesama, bakti kepada Tiāndìrén (天地人), prinsip empat pantangan (sìwù 四勿) dan lima hubungan kemasyarakatan (wǔlún 五伦) dalam keseharian.

learning_objectives.text: Murid mampu menjelaskan bakti kepada Tiān, bumi, dan sesama manusia.
